subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable memory recall eligibility and index exclusion paths for markdown-first workspaces

question: Should memory-core add a unified include/exclude path-scope config for both short-term recall eligibility and Memory Search indexing, or should maintainers narrow this to the existing memory-search exclusion PR first?
rationale: This adds public config surface and changes memory recall/index corpus semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent naming, matcher semantics, backend parity, or staged rollout on its own.

options.title: Unify recall and indexing scopes
options.body: Add one documented plugin-owned include/exclude contract shared by recall tracking, builtin indexing/watch, and QMD or an explicit QMD follow-up.

options.title: Ship search-only exclusion first
options.body: Review or repair the existing memorySearch.excludePaths PR as a narrower builtin indexing step and keep recall eligibility plus QMD parity tracked separately.

options.title: Decline broad config for now
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged and recommend workspace layout or external memory plugins for users who need generated artifacts outside search results.

recommendation.title: Unify recall and indexing scopes
recommendation.body: Add one documented plugin-owned include/exclude contract shared by recall tracking, builtin indexing/watch, and QMD or an explicit QMD follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent merged work put Vincent closest to both the memory-core runtime and config/schema surfaces involved in this decision.
